queries_evaluated.label: schema_action
queries_evaluated.reason: Schema introspection reads table metadata directly via the SQLiteDriver.getSchema path. It does not traverse Policy.checkQuery because there is no user SQL to classify; the driver runs a fixed, parameterized sqlite_master query plus PRAGMA table_info(<name>) under the dev env. Equivalent to ALLOW on a READ.
